games.name: Foot Bolt
games.desc:
Another blue lock game :0 (a lil more realistic...)

Basic Mechanics:- (PC Hotkeys)
Shooting - M1
Dribble - E
Tackle - Q
Abilities - 1 2 3 4
Awaken - G
Sidedash - Q + A/D
Sprint - F (without ball)
Dash - F (with ball)

Special Mechanics:-
Headers - Jump + Jump
Chest Traps - Jump meanwhile ball is coming towards you
Ground pass - R
Slide Tackle - Sprint + Tackle

*This is a fan-made game based on blue lock. We are not directly affiliated with it. Credits to the Blue Lock anime.
